result: Review complete. Found 3 issues in storage/trip_store.py.

findings.issue: save_trip overwrites the file directly, so a crash mid-write can corrupt the saved trip.
findings.suggestion: Write to a temporary file first, then rename it over the original.

findings.issue: TRIP_FILE is relative to the current working directory, so the app finds a different file depending on where it is run from.
findings.suggestion: Build the path from the module's own location instead.

findings.issue: load_trip does not validate the shape of the loaded data.
findings.suggestion: Check each stop has place/date/nights and raise a clear ValueError if not.
